scheme.description: Null when no supported scheme matches the string

valid.description: null is a REAL answer, not a missing one: the scheme was recognised and cannot be checked without the creditor bank configuration (KID, OCR). Never present null to a user as invalid.

check_digit_expected.description: A STRING, so a two-digit value beginning with zero survives — an OGM remainder of 3 is "03", and a remainder of 0 is written "97".

also_valid_as.description: The second reading of an ambiguous string, with its own verdict. A bare 12-digit reference is both a Belgian OGM and a legal Finnish length.

source.description: The document that publishes the rule. Null only when no scheme matched, so no rule was applied. Relay it: it is what makes the verdict auditable.

as_of.description: YYYY-MM of that document — the date it carries, never a future validity date

note.description: What was checked, and what was not

pairing_verdict.description: Pointer to POST /v1/iban/validate for the QRR/SCOR pairing verdict
